# Potted plant: a slate pot and three faceted lumps of leaves. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Pot --base-color 0.3333 0.3765 0.4902 --no-slot
material new Leaf --base-color 0.3373 0.7451 0.2667 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Pot --vertices 8 --radius1 0.22 --radius2 0.3 --depth 0.45 --location 0 0 0.225
material assign Pot
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name L0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.38 --location 0 0 0.78
add mesh ico-sphere --name L1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.3 --location 0.22 -0.1 1.12
add mesh ico-sphere --name L2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.27 --location -0.2 0.08 1.2
select L0 L1 L2
active L0
join
material assign Leaf
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 4
mode object
select Pot L0
active Pot
join
shade flat
export plant.glb
